xr.error: Deferred source callbacks must be complete

limits: Mock OpenXR runtime only; no actual SteamVR/Quest or Diablo session in these controls.
Real GPU packet buffers are updated/read back; the fixture transports pixel patterns, not pose-driven geometry.
No real game producer, GPU image leases or game queue bridge has been connected to this mailbox.
Deferred mode retains the original predicted time and can make it old; no VR cadence/latency or producer deadline policy is proven.
Session identity is in-process only; another process/IPC needs its own non-reused identity protocol.
The mailbox has a CPU mutex; all XR/Vulkan/runtime queue access must still be caller-serialized and tracked.
The strict same-scene/current-request receipt guard remains unchanged. Actual Diablo has only partial selected-geometry and successive-view evidence.
Explicit placement/scale is supported but no Diablo world/view calibration has been measured.
Native Windows D3D12 integration remains absent.
